summary: Gyomu Python Analysis is a comprehensive toolkit designed for inspecting, parsing, and analyzing Python source codebases. It provides robust capabilities for workspace and project initialization, AST-based syntactic and semantic code analysis, symbol extraction, and project snapshot change tracking.
responsibilities: Manage project and workspace configurations, source roots, and file enumerations for Python codebases.
Analyze Python source code syntax, types, constructs, and metadata via AST parsing and expression evaluation.
Track project file states, compute differences across snapshots, and validate change commitments.
Provide symbol context and dependency resolution data during code structure analysis.

capabilities.name: Workspace and Project Context Management
capabilities.description: Initializes and manages project workspaces, source roots, module caches, and configuration settings for Python code bases.

capabilities.name: Python Code Structure Analysis
capabilities.description: Performs comprehensive structural code analysis on Python constructs, including classes, functions, variables, type aliases, imports, decorators, docstrings, and dependencies.

capabilities.name: AST and Expression Processing
capabilities.description: Parses and evaluates Python statements, expressions, literals, and Abstract Syntax Trees to build symbol indexes and lookups.

capabilities.name: Snapshot and Change Tracking
capabilities.description: Creates project snapshots, monitors files, computes snapshot differences, and validates change management workflows.

design_decisions: Modularized architecture separating workspace configuration, high-level analysis orchestration, granular AST/expression inspection, and project snapshotting.
Explicit caching and module context loading to optimize repeated analysis runs within a workspace.
Specialized handling for framework features like Pydantic data models and docstring parsing alongside standard Python syntax constructs.
usage_guidance: Initialize project contexts using workspace configuration discovery to establish source roots and file enumerations before running analyses.
Leverage the core analyzers to extract structural metadata, types, and dependencies for classes, functions, and Pydantic models.
Use the snapshot module to track and diff project states over time for change detection and validation workflows.
